segments.text: In my town, an old western style house has remained
But one year the townspeople decided that it would be restored
The house had been constructed about 80 years ago
After the war it was abandoned for a long time
Its roof had crumbled and the garden was covered with weeds
Citizens raised their voices saying this building should be
Preserved as part of our heritage
The house was recognized as historically significant
Finally a restoration budget was allocated by the city
And the house was gradually repaired
The roof was redone, the walls were painted
On the day it opened, I stepped inside
In its old pillars, traces of the past were carved
Through the efforts of local people, the old building was given a new life
